# container_orchestrator/app.rb
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'securerandom'

module ContainerOrchestrator
  class AuditLog
    def self.record(action:, user:, resource:, details: {})
      entry = {
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        action: action,
        user: user,
        resource: resource,
        details: details.select { |k, _| AUDITABLE_FIELDS.include?(k.to_s) }
      }
      File.open('audit.log', 'a') { |f| f.puts(entry.to_json) }
    end

    AUDITABLE_FIELDS = %w[name image replicas cpu_limit memory_limit port].freeze
  end

  class Container
    PERMITTED_ATTRS = %w[name image replicas cpu_limit memory_limit port].freeze
    ADMIN_ATTRS = %w[privileged host_network capabilities node_selector].freeze

    attr_accessor :name, :image, :replicas, :cpu_limit, :memory_limit,
                  :port, :privileged, :host_network, :capabilities,
                  :node_selector, :owner_id

    def initialize(attrs = {})
      assign_attributes(attrs)
    end

    def assign_attributes(attrs)
      attrs.each do |key, value|
        setter = "#{key}="
        send(setter, value) if respond_to?(setter)
      end
    end

    def to_h
      { name: @name, image: @image, replicas: @replicas,
        cpu_limit: @cpu_limit, memory_limit: @memory_limit,
        port: @port, privileged: @privileged, host_network: @host_network,
        capabilities: @capabilities, node_selector: @node_selector,
        owner_id: @owner_id }
    end
  end

  class ContainerPolicy
    def initialize(user, container)
      @user = user
      @container = container
    end

    def permitted_attributes
      base = Container::PERMITTED_ATTRS.dup
      base.concat(Container::ADMIN_ATTRS) if @user[:role] == 'admin'
      base
    end

    def filter_params(params)
      allowed = permitted_attributes
      params.select { |k, _| allowed.include?(k.to_s) }
    end
  end

  class App < Sinatra::Base
    set :sessions, true
    set :session_secret, SecureRandom.hex(32)

    helpers do
      def current_user
        @current_user ||= USERS[session[:user_id]]
      end

      def authenticate!
        halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless current_user
      end

      def parse_body
        JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: false)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        halt 400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
      end
    end

    # Container deployment with policy-based filtering
    post '/api/containers' do
      authenticate!
      params = parse_body

      container = Container.new({})
      container.owner_id = current_user[:id]

      policy = ContainerPolicy.new(current_user, container)
      filtered = policy.filter_params(params)

      # Apply filtered params through policy
      container.assign_attributes(filtered)

      # Audit the deployment
      AuditLog.record(
        action: 'container.create',
        user: current_user[:username],
        resource: container.name,
        details: filtered
      )

      CONTAINERS << container
      status 201
      container.to_h.to_json
    end

    # Container update with merge semantics
    patch '/api/containers/:name' do |name|
      authenticate!
      params = parse_body

      container = CONTAINERS.find { |c| c.name == name }
      halt 404, { error: 'Not found' }.to_json unless container

      unless container.owner_id == current_user[:id] || current_user[:role] == 'admin'
        halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json
      end

      policy = ContainerPolicy.new(current_user, container)
      filtered = policy.filter_params(params)

      # Deep merge: apply update profile if specified
      if params['update_profile']
        profile = UPDATE_PROFILES[params['update_profile']]
        if profile
          merged = profile.merge(filtered)
          container.assign_attributes(merged)
        else
          container.assign_attributes(filtered)
        end
      else
        container.assign_attributes(filtered)
      end

      AuditLog.record(
        action: 'container.update',
        user: current_user[:username],
        resource: container.name,
        details: filtered
      )

      container.to_h.to_json
    end

    USERS = {
      1 => { id: 1, username: 'admin', role: 'admin' },
      2 => { id: 2, username: 'developer', role: 'user' }
    }.freeze

    CONTAINERS = []

    # Update profiles define default attributes for common operations
    UPDATE_PROFILES = {
      'rolling' => { 'replicas' => 3 },
      'canary' => { 'replicas' => 1 },
      'debug' => { 'privileged' => true, 'host_network' => true, 'capabilities' => 'ALL' }
    }.freeze
  end
end
